relationship_groups.summary: Chemceed quote price estimate workflow began as a custom report/tool, then was extended to support sourcing copied from quote, later refined through testing for rounding, profit, and decimal precision.
Chemceed shipment and delivery logic for pickup address and manufacturer evolved through several linked projects, with later shipment-based behavior preferred over earlier logic.
Chemceed’s specification and COA workflows include uploads, heading rules, customer-vs-purchase spec behavior, training, special document availability rules, and follow-up defect testing.
Customer contact selection and generated-email behavior were progressively customized across Quote, SO, PO, Invoice, and document-email workflows.
Chemceed PO logic includes sub-statuses, package-based entry, document changes, delivery-vs-pickup labeling logic, and displaying both product and vendor product names when they differ.
Job Build functionality was configured, tested, trained, and repeatedly refined around assemblies, costs, package handling, and allocation behavior.
Many Chemceed issues trace back to imported data, mapping rules, naming conversions, and assumptions applied during uploads and clean-up.
Sales Order and Quote behavior depends on customer contact selection, ship-to-driven delivery information, and correct customer ID inheritance.
Chemceed logistics documents were extensively customized across warehouse arrival, delivery instructions, BOL, pallet labels, Freight Order, COA availability, and shipment link behavior.
Chemceed accounting issues commonly involve QuickBooks configuration, posting failures, GL mapping, invoice and cost batch errors, COGS handling, and prepayment behavior.
Chemceed CRM behavior includes vendor/customer contact logic, prefiltered scans, opportunity-linked downstream entities, custom alerts, incident/sourcing request menus, and richer activity linking.
